Jordan — quick legal note and proposed prioritization for redlines:

Priority 1 (must-resolve before POC): data residency guarantee wording, subprocessor notification window (30 days), and confidentiality carve-outs for customer data.
Priority 2 (commercial): indemnity cap tied to fees (we propose 3x 12 months' fees), export control language, and SLA credits.
Priority 3 (nice-to-have): reverse IP assignment language and survival clauses.

We cannot accept open-ended liability or an indemnity that includes third-party equity claims. I'm attaching inline redlines to Redwood_MSA_Template_v3.docx — please review and call out any absolute deal-breakers.

Action owner summary:
- Jordan: confirm whether TractionLabs can accept a 30-day subprocessor notice vs. immediate consent
- Mina: confirm POC seat estimates and billing contact
- David: prepare order form draft once seat & term confirmed

I'll upload the redline packet to the shared drive and send a link by EOD. If you prefer a short call to walk through the must-resolves, I can do 30 minutes tomorrow (4/6) at 9am PT.
